question: Does an ability that triggers when a creature attacks and is not blocked, like frenzy, trigger for a creature that was put onto the battlefield attacking and is not blocked?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it triggers after blockers are declared if the creature is attacking and no creature blocks it, even if it was put onto the battlefield attacking.
expected.answer: An ability that triggers when something “attacks and isn’t blocked” triggers in the declare blockers step after blockers are declared if (1) that creature is attacking and (2) no creatures are declared to block it. It will trigger even if that creature was put onto the battlefield attacking rather than having been declared as an attacker in the declare attackers step.
